fields.statement: Verified at 17be6dbf (attempt 2). rhiza workflow check ship-change: valid (builtin), and the built-in's wait-ci-rerun until is 'rhiza ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra' (internal/workflow/builtin/ship-change.toml:162, asserted in workflow_test.go:457). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-(infra-wait|rerun-fail)': both PASS. Read the diff: run-ship-infra-wait's fake gh now gives Actions run 42 (detailsUrl .../actions/runs/42/job/N), run view logs with no failing test, and turns green only after the second 'run rerun'; the script itself never reruns. A bin/rhiza shim only backdates red_at (the test clock is fixed) and logs --rerun-infra polls; the script asserts two 'run rerun 42 --failed' lines and that the second directly follows a 'rhiza ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra' poll, so the wait issued it. Run status shows ci-triage fail -> wait-ci-rerun pass -> pr-green (visit 2) pass -> signoff. Attempt 1's finding (rerun simulated by the fake's queue) is fixed.
